notes: §1985:VII.4.4.3 SR1: "The storage area associated with identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 must not be the same storage area." SequentialIoBinder.BindRead binds INTO through MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase, which asks StatementValidation.CheckIntoReceiver, then CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea (RecordAreaRule.InForce: Year < 2023) and StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf. Probes (work-rd-09/ov o1-o9, p1, p2, rv1, rv2): b) refused COBOL6827: INTO the file's record (the witness), INTO another 01 of the same FD (equal or shorter), INTO a subordinate item at offset 0 of full width, INTO a record of a file named with it in SAME RECORD AREA; accepted: INTO a W-S item (run correct), INTO a shorter subordinate item (a partial overlap, outside 'the same storage area'); c) refused at --std 2002 (§2002:14.8.29.2 SR2) and accepted at 2023, where the overlap rules apply. a) RECORD IS VARYING: INTO a shorter 01 of the file refused, INTO W-S accepted and moved the 4-character record ('ABCD'). NOT implemented for two shapes that are exactly the record area: INTO INR(1:) or INR(1:10) (a reference modification spanning the record) and INTO a level-66 RENAMES of the record's first THRU last item compile clean (o5, o6, o7); IsRecordAreaOf excludes both by design. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-09.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now.

next.reason: 1985: "The storage area associated with identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 must not be the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, General rules, apply to any cases in which ... share any part". 1985 refuses programs whose identifier-1 is the record area. 2023 has no such syntax rule; shared storage is allowed and handled by the overlapping-operand/MOVE rules, possibly undefined.
